caption: The smart contract applies the policy's own numbers, a ₹5,00,000 sum insured and a ₹10,000 deductible, to a ₹1,20,000 claim and releases ₹1,10,000. Storing the claim hash in the audit log is what stops the same bill being paid twice.

spec.title: Insurance claim on a shared ledger
spec.aria: A downward flow: an active policy with ₹5,00,000 sum insured, a ₹1,20,000 claim event submitted to a smart contract that applies a ₹10,000 deductible, a ₹1,10,000 payout, and an audit log holding the claim hash.
